page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of the opening). Running head at top; page number 234 at top left. Main text in one column of Greek grammar tables with marginal labels in the left margin (Nosce, Nosco, Nosceba, Futurum, Notio). Catchword "De" at lower right.

main_text.head: IMPERATIVVS.
Præsens.
main_text.p: Nosce.ἴσθι, et assumpto τ' ἴσθι, per Syncopen ἴθι cognosce, uel sis: nā Imperatiuo sub stantiui coincidit, ἰσάτω uel ἴσθω. ἴσατον uel ἴσον, ἰσάτων uel ἴσθων. ἴσατε ἴστε, ἰσάτωσαν uel ἴσθωσαν & ἴσθων.
main_text.head: INDICATIVVS medij.
Præsens.
main_text.p: Nosco.ἴσταμαι ἴστασαι ἵσταται. ἱσάμεθον ἵστασθον ἵστασθον. ἱσάμεθα ἵστασθε ἵστανται. Et τ interposito ἱσταμαι ἱστασαι ἱσταται, & cum ἐπὶ compositum, ἐπίσταμαι ἐπίστασαι ἐπίσταται, &c.
main_text.head: Imperfectum.
main_text.p: Nosceba.ἐπιστάμην ἐπίστασο, Ionice ἐπίστασο. Crasi ἐπίστω ἐπίσατο.
main_text.head: Futurum.
main_text.p: Futurum.ἐπιστήσομαι cognoscam, quod futuro compositio uerbi ἵστημι coincidit, ἵστημι στήσω, στήσομαι, ἐπιστήσομαι superstitem.
Notio.In μι bisyllaba, penultimā circumflectunt, γνόω γνῶμι, σχέω σχῆμι, præter φημί εἰμί.

page.notes: Greek text is reproduced from the scan as closely as legible; several polytonic accents and breathings in the paradigm tables are uncertain. The marginal labels are set in italic/black-letter-like type. The catchword "De" sits at lower right of the text block.
